assets.name: Sage_AI System Context
assets.notes: Fifth release. The system instructions as in the library on 11/16/2026. Both plugins are tested. The plugins cannot trigger the refresh of a linked table, so Sage_AI lists the documents that embed it and asks the Product Owner to refresh each one. No script applies edits to a Document. The Sage_AI Doc Edits skill and the Sage_AI Edits script are retired and removed from the repository. The 20261114 and 20261112 files stay as history. Sixth release, the same day, so it replaces the 20261116 file. The mission rules carry the brief outline, the live doc practice, and the brief for the next mission as a standard closing deliverable. Deliver Changes to Documents gains two rules for linked tables. Sage_AI Skill and Sage_AI Context point to the Lexicon. Seventh release. Sage_AI reads the Product Meta and the Advisory Board from dated Markdown files in the Product Owner's Drive, and the overrides moved from the Project Instructions into the Product Meta. The Project Instructions are a fixed stub. Sage_AI reads each Growth Factor AI Meta from the clone, with the website page as the fallback. A Skills section names how a skill is installed. The Product Owner LinkedIn Content skill is published at version 1. Eighth release. The Product Meta Skeleton is in the repository and Sage_AI builds the first Product Meta from it. The Advisory Board is no longer written for a new Product Owner. Named assets are written with capitals and led by their names. Stub and Skeleton point to the Lexicon. A version pending the Product Owner's signature is put in front of them with a link before the mission closes.

assets.name: Sage_AI Product Owner LinkedIn Content
assets.notes: First release. Turns a transcript, a captured interview, or a Sage_AI interview into fifteen LinkedIn posts, each with three hooks, image text, share text, and an HTML image card, as one validated ProductSage import file. Reads the Product Owner's content profile for envelope values, brand slots, and style overrides. Carries templates A to O, the style rules, the import format at schema version 1.0, the interview questions, and a validator with a self test.

assets.name: Sage_AI Project Instructions Stub
assets.notes: First release. The fixed Project Instructions for Sage_AI 3.0. It is the same for every Product Owner and has one optional slot, the Product Meta folder ID. Paste it into the Project Instructions. Where the version line in the installed stub is older than this version, paste the new stub and carry the folder ID across.

assets.name: Product Meta Skeleton
assets.notes: First release. The structure and rules of the Product Meta, with bracketed variables and blanks. Sage_AI copies it and fills it in with the Product Owner, then writes the result as a dated file in the Product Owner's Drive. It is filled in and not used as it is.

assets.name: Growth Factor AI Meta
assets.notes: One folder for each Growth Factor, named by its slug. Each folder holds dated files, AI_Meta_{slug}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, and the latest date in the name is live. Older files stay as history. The website AI Meta page is the fallback.
